# CAA Record Checker

> Enter a hostname to see the CAA record set that governs certificate issuance per RFC 8659, and which CAs may issue. Only public DNS is read; nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/caa-record-check/)
- [Why a CAA Record Blocks Certificate Issuance](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/caa-record-check/how-caa-blocks-certificate-issuance.html)
- [CAA Record Checker vs. a Plain DNS Lookup](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/caa-record-check/vs-a-plain-dns-lookup.html)
